أندهش (form VII)
# أَنْدَهِشُ (ʔandahišu) /ʔan.da.hi.ʃu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
# أَنْدَهِشَ (ʔandahiša) /ʔan.da.hi.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
# أَنْدَهِشْ (ʔandahiš) /ʔan.da.hiʃ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
